title: Resolution urging Albany to shift SCHE income checks to the state
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature to pass, and the Governor to sign, S.4805/A.4984, which would move income verification for the Senior Citizen Homeowners' Exemption from New York City's Department of Finance to the state Department of Taxation and Finance. Supporters say the change would ease paperwork for older homeowners and reduce administrative burden on the city.
